blind.description: A stylised four-poster canopy bed featuring carved dark wood posts with spherical finials, an ornate patterned wooden canopy ceiling, draped golden-olive curtains gathered at each corner post, a tall headboard, low footboard, and bedding consisting of cream-colored pillows, sheets, and a rich red patterned quilt.
blind.from_above: A framed rectangular wooden panel decorated with an ornate, symmetrical golden-brown inlay or painted crest pattern, bordered by heavy dark wood molding with rounded corner finials.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 to 6.5 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), about 5 feet wide and 6.5 feet long.
